name: @workspace/api-types
description: TypeScript types generated from the services' OpenAPI specs (PRD §7: CI fails on drift).

scripts.generate: pnpm --filter @insightflow/auth-node spec:dump && pnpm --filter @insightflow/data-py spec:dump && pnpm exec openapi-typescript openapi/auth.json -o src/auth.d.ts && pnpm exec openapi-typescript openapi/data.json -o src/data.d.ts
